subject: Recast of Exhibit D + redline workshop for amendment
messages:
From: Emily Sands <emily.sands@helioshealth.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@helioshealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: amendment to support seasonal burst + fee ladder change

Hi Rishi,

We're preparing for a Q2 pilot that will spike inference usage for a 6-week window. We need an amendment to our MSA/Order Form that: 1) grants a temporary burst pool (capacity add) with a defined billing ladder, 2) adjusts the fee schedule for sustained usage above 10M tokens, and 3) clarifies implementation timeline and rollback protections if performance doesn't meet the SLA.

Procurement wants a redline and a target signing date of Feb 3 so finance can align budgets. Attached is a short deck explaining the expected traffic pattern and preferred billing cadence.

Can Redwood propose language for Exhibit D (billing/tiers) and an approach for how credits / retro-billing would work if the burst is decommissioned early? Also please include a recommended test/fallback period so we can sign without exposing ourselves to surprise charges.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call.

Emily Sands
Head of Platform Ops, Helios Health
Attachments: helios_burst_deck.pdf

From: rishi.malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Emily Sands <emily.sands@helioshealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: amendment to support seasonal burst + fee ladder change

Thanks, Emily — got it.

High level plan from our side:
- Internal redline workshop (45 min) to scope Exhibit D recast + sample fee ladder (Rishi / Laura / Karthik / Markus).
- Deliver draft redline (Word) + pricing spreadsheet by Jan 12.
- Legal and Procurement sync week of Jan 15 for comments.
- Target final for signature: Feb 3 (DocuSign link to follow).

Questions we need answered up front:
1) Is the burst strictly temporary (fixed calendar window) or usage-triggered?
2) Do you want retroactive credits if Helios terminates burst early, or a pro-rata refund?
3) Any change to data residency, export controls, or audit requirements tied to the burst?

Laura — can you prepare a sample fee ladder tied to the deck's traffic tiers? Karthik — please map impacts to orderform SKU and billing ledger. Markus — need your guidance on acceptable rollback language/retro-billing mechanics.

I'll set a 45-min workshop for Thursday 1/12 8:30am PT and include a Zoom. If that time doesn't work for Helios folks we'll shift.

Rishi
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, Emily Sands <emily.sands@helioshealth.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 11:18:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Request: amendment to support seasonal burst + fee ladder change

Emily / team — thanks for the deck; helpful context. Drafting notes attached (pricing_schedule_v2.xlsx). Key points:
- Proposed temporary burst SKU: BURST-XL (billed per token at elevated rate during window).
- Fee ladder: baseline unit rate, >10M tokens moves to Sustained tier discount, >25M tokens hits enterprise band. See attached spreadsheet with sample monthly impacts.
- Suggest pro-rata credit if Helios shuts down the burst before the end of the calendar window, with a 14-day notice to avoid immediate pro-rata complexity.
- Recommend a 7-day test window at the start of the burst where both parties validate latency/throughput against agreed signals; if metrics fall below SLA the parties can pause without billing beyond baseline.

Next steps: I will attach a quick redline (redlines_proposed.docx) to seed the workshop. Monica — can you confirm whether billing system supports lookback credits or only prospective adjustments?

Laura Bennett
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Attachments: pricing_schedule_v2.xlsx, redlines_proposed.docx

From: markus.klein@redwood.com <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Emily Sands <emily.sands@helioshealth.com>, Glen.Reynolds@vendorlaw.com
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 07:45:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Request: amendment to support seasonal burst + fee ladder change

Folks — reviewing the ask from a legal POV. Quick guidance and open items before we send formal redlines:
- Retroactive billing / credits: we prefer pro-rata credits (credit to account) rather than refunding payments. If Helios insists on refunds, procurement should expect a longer legal review.
- Term and rollback: propose a clause that allows either party to terminate the burst with 14 days' notice and obligates Redwood to reconcile charges for the current billing period (i.e., pro-rata credit). Avoid open-ended retro-billing windows.
- SLA test window: allow a 7-day "acceptance" window where failure triggers a pause with no burst charges; define objective pass/fail metrics (p95 latency, error rate) and the monitoring source (Redwood console trace ID).
- Data controls: confirm no change to data residency or access — if Helios adds a new region, separate security review required.

Glen — can you please review the attached wording (I'll paste the proposed clause in the workshop doc) and flag any procurement-law concerns on the refund vs credit approach?

Markup items I'll propose in the draft: detailed billing matrix in Exhibit D, a short "Burst Termination" clause, and an appendix that specifies the acceptance metrics and monitoring endpoints.

-Markus
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Glen Reynolds <glen.reynolds@vendorlaw.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com, Emily Sands <emily.sands@helioshealth.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 10:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: amendment to support seasonal burst + fee ladder change

Markus — high level comment from Helios counsel:
- Credit vs refund: Procurement will push for refund language unless Redwood can show billing system limitations. Recommend we offer credit as standard and carve out a refund only where Helios can demonstrate material overbilling by Redwood.
- Lookback window: limit retroactive adjustments to billing errors discovered within 45 days of invoice. Beyond that, adjustments only by mutual agreement.
- Indemnity/limitation: double-check that the burst clause doesn't inadvertently broaden liability during the acceptance window; suggest we keep existing MSA indemnity caps intact.

If you can provide redline language for the 14-day termination, the 7-day acceptance test, and the 45-day billing lookback, I can run it through Helios legal quickly. Can we aim to have a redline by Jan 12 EOD?

Glen Reynolds
Partner, VendorLaw LLP

From: rishi.malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Cc: Emily Sands <emily.sands@helioshealth.com>, Glen.Reynolds@vendorlaw.com
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 16:05:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Request: amendment to support seasonal burst + fee ladder change — workshop follow-up

Thanks everyone — quick summary and owners: 
- Workshop confirmed: Thu 1/12 08:30 PT (Zoom link in calendar).
- Deliverables by end of day Jan 12: redlines_proposed.docx (Markus/Laura), Exhibit-D_recast_v1.pdf (Laura), pricing_schedule_v2.xlsx (Laura).
- Legal asks captured: 14-day termination + pro-rata credit default; 7-day acceptance test with objective metrics; 45-day billing lookback for invoice corrections (Glen flagged). Markus to include draft clause text.
- Karthik/Monica: confirm billing system handles pro-rata credits by Jan 12 EOD; if not, flag alternatives in the workshop.

Next steps after Jan 12: incorporate Helios feedback in final amendment and prepare DocuSign envelope for Feb 3 target. Emily — please confirm any internal procurement blackout dates that would prevent signature on Feb 3.

I'll compile the redlines after the workshop and circulate.

Rishi
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
